text:
alex: quick follow-up from the PM postmortem — we're still seeing intermittent OOMs traced to 'ghost' KV allocations that never free. we need clear owners and a short remediation plan.

maria: +1. i can own the profiling work (heap/kv stack traces across replicas). target: initial findings by EOD Thu. :mag:

jon: assigning myself to GC tuning experiments and fragmentation mitigation. i'll run a controlled staging workload and try aggressive GC windows. plan ETA: next Tue.

sam: i'll take limits/enforcement (soft cap + circuit breaker) so we avoid customer-impact while we debug. will PR a guard with metrics by Mon. :shield:

kevin: good — please add feature flags so we can rollback quickly. i can wire the flagging in the deploy pipeline.

alex: action items to confirm: (1) profiling (maria) -> EOD Thu, (2) GC experiments (jon) -> Tue, (3) runtime caps (sam) -> Mon, (4) deploy flags (kevin) -> before any prod change.

maria: profiling plan: 1) sample heap on 30s interval 2) capture KV allocation stacks 3) correlate with request ids. adding a tiny eBPF tracer on one staging replica.

jon: experiment plan: lower GC threshold from 70%->50%, enable background compaction, and run a 'fragmentation burn' test we already have in qa. will post results and memory timelines.

sam: soft cap design: token-bucket per model-shard, fallback to LRU eviction + emit eviction events to tracing. will include Prometheus metrics: kv_evictions_total, kv_usage_percent.

kevin: CI changes: add a gating test that fails if mem spike > 10% over baseline during smoke. i'll add to release job. ci-bot: will post status once tests run.

ci-bot: nightly run scheduled for 2026-05-05T02:00Z, will report pass/fail to #eng-runtime.

alex: risks: this might hide root cause if caps mask leak. plan is to use caps as safety only, not long-term fix. also need to watch perf regression from extra evictions.

maria: noted. i'll include allocation origin heatmap so we can see if certain request paths cause ghosts.

jon: if GC tuning reduces fragmentation but allocations still grow, consider a KV refcount audit — might need small API changes.

sam: timeline check: syncing daily standups until fixes merged. weekly postmortem follow-up on Fridays.

alex: owners confirmed. i'll update the postmortem doc and create a short runbook for oncall steps (how to detect, temporary mitigations). tagging @maria @jon @sam @kevin.

maria: ack. starting profiling now.

jon: ack. will start experiments tonight.

sam: ack. drafting cap PR.

kevin: ack. adding flags + CI gate.

alex: thanks all. please drop PR links and short status updates in this thread so i can track before Friday sync. :thumbsup:
